title: Can a hotel bar run out of tokens?
situation: The Token Hotel bar runs out of tokens, so Vex must mix drinks with nothing at all.

goals.Vex: Serve every guest a proper cocktail without breaking the bar's token rules.
goals.Pierce: Fetch the tokens quickly and be told he did a good job for once.
goals.Madame Halloran: Keep the bar running in a respectable manner, with the proper paperwork.
goals.Lady Token: Get one cheap drink without spending more than one word on it.
goals.Miss Agentic: Get four cocktails delivered by someone else while taking all the credit.

secrets.Lady Token: She has a jar of unspent tokens hidden in her handbag.
secrets.Pierce: He secretly keeps the hotel's old coat-check tickets in his pocket for luck.
